metadata.description:
Initial public release of SEPARATE associated with the accepted JOSS paper.

SEPARATE is a tool for partitioning tipping-bucket rainfall data into storm events and calculating event rainfall metrics.

Highlights:

  • Provides GUI and non-GUI workflows
  • Storm event partitioning methods
  • Rainfall metric calculations and plotting

For installation and usage, see the README and documentation in this repository.
